Now. Mender. There are twenty-three people in my Rot House with black in their veins.
Then what are you standing here for?
Ilse doesn't sleep that night. Neither does Doctor Vey.
By dawn there is a draught beside every bed in the Rot House, and Vey has the recipe written on the inside of his sleeve.
Mirefen will need a Mender when I'm gone, you know. A proper one.
Don't tell me what you're not. Tell me what you want.
I want to go to the Collegium in Aurenne. To study. Properly.
Not out of Nana's book. Not because I happen to be the one standing there.
Then want it out loud, girl. Wanting quietly never got anybody anything.
Here. For your rounds. Reed and silver wire — keeps the fen-fevers off. Mostly.
Find Elowen, the oldest Keeper, at the heart of the Thornwood in Verdance. (Leave Mirefen by the north path.)

Mother Osk is alive. The Choir took her Dawnstone while she was too sick to stop them — Cassian's people. She looked at Sable and said, "Oh, Cassian. What have you done." Ilse wants to go to the Collegium. She never told me. I never asked.
